objective: Make state commits work when the state branch tracks no file under .holyagent yet, which fails 45 tests in CI.
scope: CI run https://github.com/davidbasilefilho/holyagent/actions/runs/41544344413 on 02df5d8 fails 45 tests (state-branch, vcs-commit, migrate, process and CLI tests). Error: StateIo ... git add -u -- .holyagent :(exclude).holyagent/local exited 128: error: pathspec '.holyagent' did not match any file(s) known to git; error: pathspec ':(exclude).holyagent/local' did not match any file(s) known to git. Source: stageState in packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts (added in 386cb22). Locally all tests pass, so the local git likely tolerates the unmatched pathspec where the CI runner's git does not; compare git versions (local `git --version`, CI ubuntu runner) and reproduce, for example by running the failing tests with the CI's git behavior or by a test on a state branch with no tracked .holyagent file.

Fix: only run the tracked-change staging when git tracks a path under .holyagent (for example check git ls-files first, or stage tracked paths by name), so a first state commit works on every supported git version. Keep the staging scope: records, config and migrate's copied paths only, never a stray file.
constraints: Do not touch instruction text or docs.
No version-control writes (no git add on the project, checkout, switch, stash, commit) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/ of the project; test repos in temp dirs are fine. Report changed paths.
Rebuild dist with bun packages/integrations/claude/build.ts at the end, since the bundled CLI includes tree.ts.
Keep working until done; when done and checked, stop and report. Respond tersely.

evidence:
- Root cause: The cause is a guess; I could not run CI's git. Local git is 2.43.0. It exits 0 for `git add -u -- .holyagent ':(exclude).holyagent/local'` when the folder holds only untracked files. For a path that does not exist, 2.43.0 prints `fatal: pathspec 'nonexist' did not match any files` and exits 128. CI's error text, `error: pathspec ... did not match any file(s) known to git`, has a different wording and prefix than anything 2.43.0 printed. So the CI runner's git is probably newer and rejects an `add -u` pathspec that matches no tracked file. That happens on the first state commit, when nothing under `.holyagent` is tracked yet.
- Fix: tree.ts `stageState` runs `git ls-files -- .holyagent ':(exclude).holyagent/local'` first and skips `add -u` when it prints nothing. The regression test "the first commit on a state branch that tracks nothing yet" puts a `git` wrapper on PATH that exits 128 for an `add -u` whose pathspec matches no tracked file. It passes with the fix. With the guard temporarily replaced by `if (true)`, it fails: `intent create` throws. I restored the guard afterwards.
- Regressions: the full `bun test` passed, including the stray-file test, the migrate staging test and the rest of state-branch, vcs-commit, migrate and CLI. Staging scope is unchanged: the `-f` add of the files in STATE_FILE and the files migrate copied.
- Gates: `bun check --no-script`, `bun lint --no-script`, `bun fmt --no-script --check` and `bun test` all exited 0 after the dist rebuild.
- changed-paths: the three paths listed under `changed:`.
- checks-run: the commands and results listed under `checks:`.

acceptance.rationale: Guard skips add -u when git ls-files finds no tracked state file; regression test with a git wrapper that rejects an unmatched pathspec fails without the guard and passes with it; full bun test 997 pass; root-cause version unverified but the fix does not depend on it.
